paragraphs: Anglia Ruskin University (ARU) is a public university based in Cambridge, England, with additional campuses in Chelmsford, Peterborough and London. ARU's roots go back to 1858 as the Cambridge School of Art. Today ARU is best known for music, art and design, health sciences, business, and the prestigious Cambridge School of Optometry.

International students enter via Anglia Ruskin University College (ARUC) — Navitas's pathway college on the Cambridge campus. International Foundation Year and Pre-Master programs lead into an ARU Bachelor's or Master's degree.
paragraphsRu: Anglia Ruskin University (ARU) — государственный университет в Кембридже, дополнительные кампусы в Челмсфорде, Питерборо и Лондоне. Истоки — Cambridge School of Art (1858). Известен музыкой, искусством и дизайном, health sciences, бизнесом и престижной Cambridge School of Optometry.

Международные студенты заходят через Anglia Ruskin University College (ARUC) — pathway-колледж Navitas на кампусе в Кембридже. International Foundation Year и Pre-Master программы ведут в бакалавриат / магистратуру ARU.
